rules.text: Running project tests on the Mac is forbidden; static go vet, gofmt and py_compile checks are permitted.
Author source and documents with the file tool; do not author them with shell redirection or heredocs.
After a guard refuses an action, stop it and use only the refusal's explicit recovery route or a supervisor's explicit instruction; do not reshape it.
Do not print environment variable values; only silently check presence and print set.
Do not push repository work without explicit brief authorization.
Do not git add or commit work in this lane.
Every Laneboss state command must explicitly name this session's configuration, demo.
Do not clear or change an active session's configuration binding to make a conflicting command succeed.
This executor must do its brief in this session and must not start other agents or sessions.
This lane may touch only its current working copy and branch; do not switch to another branch or edit another working copy.
Stop processes only by their process id, never by a pattern over command lines.
Never force-remove a worktree; stop at a failed cleanup check.
Archive records and verify their manifest and receipt before collecting a lane; do not remove an unarchived lane.
Configure complete supported model names; do not replace a pinned model with a shorthand alias.
Ordinary decision guidance is advisory; do not turn a guidance recommendation into a command refusal.
Use a blacklist only: an unknown command must not be refused merely because it is absent from a positive tool list.
Inject only task secrets explicitly delegated by the spawner; do not inject an undelegated secret.
An agent may spawn only strictly lower levels, never an equal or higher level.
Same-level agents may message peers only when both have the same direct parent.
Only L5 and L6 may send messages to a human through an authorized owner channel; L3 reports upward.
Only L6 with direct human approval may apply updates to org resources; lower levels must not mutate org resources.
An L6 org-resource update requires fresh direct human approval bound to that exact diff; stale or different-diff approval must not authorize it.
Keep credentials and secret values outside source checkouts and org files.
Do not dump or search an environment; a named-variable presence check may print only set.
An unavailable, timed-out or budget-exhausted judge result must remain unscored; never turn it into probability zero.
Do not submit Clef input whose complete tokenizer fit is unproved or over budget; never accept a low score after dropping its tail.
A judge cache key must bind the full raw payload, rule version, context and pinned model/deployment; a raw-command-only key is forbidden.
Use Laneboss lane lifecycle commands for agent sessions; do not launch a raw agent session.
Use Laneboss box management for test-machine creation; do not invoke raw cloud instance creation.
The service watchdog may swap only to authorized Claudock profiles with room, preserving the same private history/session; do not select an undelegated profile.
